# Wezu Technologies

> Wezu Technologies develops hardware, software and engineering systems for vehicles, transportation and mobility platforms.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://wezutech.com/): Company overview, products, industries, testimonials and contact details.
- [About](https://wezutech.com/about): Capabilities, engineering process and company focus.
- [Sitemap](https://wezutech.com/sitemap.xml): Current public page and product URLs.

## Core capabilities

- Vehicle thermal management and electrification systems
- Vehicle control, diagnostics and connected electronics
- OEM/ODM engineering and turnkey product development
- Research, manufacturing and product-lifecycle support

## Industries

Automotive, marine, agriculture and mining, locomotive, special-purpose vehicles, aerospace and UAV.
